messages.text:
Your brass floor lamp can be refunded, and I've created a new proposal for **48.90 BRL** (refund-policy/v2/amount).

- **Why the earlier proposal expired:** Proposal h469-p1 lapsed before it was paid. A proposal is only valid for 72 hours after it is created, so a new one was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity).
- **Single payment:** A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one valid payment record, and it goes only to that payment (refund-policy/v2/payment). Your order has one valid payment record. I can't see from the records whether it was paid by voucher. The refund will go to that original payment.

**Next steps:**
1. Confirm the proposal with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count.
2. A staff member then reviews and approves it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
